utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure who's running it, Mina. I just heard it's happening Saturday at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Actually, I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center. Just a heads up!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Mara! That changes things.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik, are you free this Saturday? There's a repair drive at the community center at 9 AM!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I thought it was at 10 AM! But yeah, it's this Saturday, you should come help fix up the garden tools!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, it's definitely 9 AM! I'll be there to help—see you then!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks for understanding, Bo. I'll be there around 10 or so.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Dane. I'll have my truck loaded with tools ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I'll grab my wrench and see you then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's a community fix-up day; bring broken stuff to repair. It's Sunday now, at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Sunday! I'll be there, though I might forget my tools again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll bring extra tools. See you Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure this repair drive is actually happening? I've heard about these things before and nothing came of it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I double-checked the flyer at the community center. It's this Saturday at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I guess I'll believe it when I see volunteers with gadgets. Did you say it's at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Cleo, do you know if Rosa has that list of houses? I need to start planning the route.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm not sure about Rosa's list, but we're still short on lumber. Can you check with the Henderson house?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I'll swing by the Henderson place and ask about lumber. Have you seen Rosa yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who's running the repair drive this time?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Cleo is organizing it, actually. I'm helping with the logistics—keeping a map of where help is needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you have a list of houses already, or are you still collecting them?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Honestly, I'm still worried about how we're going to coordinate everyone's schedules for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, I thought it was Saturday? Did it change?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, it's on Sunday now. I'm just anxious about getting everyone's timing straight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: The repair drive is this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center. We're fixing up old garden tools and other stuff. You should come, Oren!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard about it! I was planning to stop by and help out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, Ira! We'll be happy to have you there. Bring your own gloves if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Eli, there's a repair drive this Saturday from 10 to 4. Gus is organizing it and bringing his tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hold on, I thought Mara said it was moved to Sunday? Can you double-check the date and time?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Huh, I thought it was Saturday. Let me check with Gus to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I saw something about it... sorry, I can't remember where.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's at the community center, this Saturday at 10. I'll be there, hope you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Saturday at 10? I'll try to remember that. Maybe I'll put it in my phone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? It's at the community center at 9 AM Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Tess, actually I just found out it's been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, really? I thought it was Saturday! Thanks for letting me know, Rosa — I'll update my plans.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Vik, I'm organizing a repair drive and we're really short on lumber. Do you happen to have any spare boards?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive is this Saturday at 10 AM! I don't have spare lumber, but maybe we can check the community shed together.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great idea! Let's head over there now and see what we can find.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! I think I saw a flyer about that... somewhere. Sorry, I misplaced it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries, Noah! Do you remember any details from the flyer, like who's organizing it or what we're supposed to bring?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, I think Faye said she'd send me a picture of it. Maybe check with her?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, yeah the repair drive on Saturday, 9 AM. I'll try to make it if my errands don't take too long.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Actually, it's Sunday now, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, Sunday? Okay, I guess I got the day mixed up. Still 9 AM?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, there's a repair drive this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. We're fixing up garden tools and could really use your help!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, Sam, are you sure it's Saturday? Mara mentioned it was moved to Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Really? I thought it was Saturday. Let me double-check with Gus.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Hana, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I think it's the one at the community center on Saturday at 9 AM, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it's actually at 10 AM, not 9. Gus mentioned he's got his truck loaded with tools, so it's definitely happening.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Mina, have you seen the sign-up sheet for the repair drive? I need to coordinate schedules.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I think Rosa is organizing it—have you checked with her?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, Rosa has the list. I'll try to catch her after school.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, thanks for reminding me about the repair drive. I'll be there a bit late, but I'll bring some spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Dane! Every bit helps. I'll mark you down for 10 AM then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Alright, see you Saturday! I'll try not to be too late.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Kira, I've got my truck all loaded with tools for the repair drive this Saturday. You coming?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure this repair drive is actually happening? I've heard about these things before and nothing came of it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got the tools and I'm ready to go, so it's definitely happening this time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, are you free this Saturday? There's a repair drive at the community center at 9 AM!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I heard it was at 10! But either way, I'm planning to go—Gus is bringing his truck full of tools, and Dane said he might be a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, 10? Must've mixed it up. Great that you're coming—it'll be fun!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Tess! I heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday. Just wanted to make sure you knew!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks Mara! Pia actually just told me that too—I'm glad you both looked out for me. I'd have shown up at the wrong time!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good, I'm glad you're in the loop! I'm bringing my broken toaster—are you planning on bringing anything?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh, that thing with Gus's tools? I think I remember now...

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, exactly! Just a heads up—it's been moved to Sunday at the community center instead. Hope you can join!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Sunday? That might actually work—I think I'm free then. But I'll probably forget my tools again.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Uli, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? Gus is organizing it on Saturday from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I heard about it. I'll be there a bit late, got some errands to run first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Actually, I just heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center.
